objective: server/services/russell/work.ts groupOfBin (~L174) returns 'WORKING_NOW' for any LEASED bin regardless of leaseExpiresAt; an expired lease is claimable work with nobody on it and belongs in 'UP_NEXT'. Fix: groupOfBin(bin, now = Date.now()); LEASED with a parseable leaseExpiresAt <= now returns 'UP_NEXT'; missing/null expiry stays 'WORKING_NOW' (tests/readLayer.test.ts calls it with no leaseExpiresAt and expects WORKING_NOW).
expectedOutcome: A bin whose lease has expired is not shown as being worked on.

acceptanceConditions.statement: an expired-lease bin groups as UP_NEXT, with a test that fails before the fix

rollbackRequirement: Revert the commit; no schema or data change.
